summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including integration with Spark 4.1 and the introduction of collation support for flexible string comparisons. Additionally, there are ongoing discussions about improving the REST API with fine-grained access control and addressing issues related to the latest pyiceberg-core release.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal for collation support in Iceberg
Discussion on adding 404 response for /v1/config endpoint
Enhancements to storage credential refresh mechanism
